title: A Test of Acceptance-based Bibliotherapy for Hoarding Disorder
official: A Test of Acceptance-based Bibliotherapy for Hoarding Disorder
summary: The investigators are proposing to test an Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) based bibliotherapy intervention as a self-help approach to hoarding disorder. Participants will be 60 adults meeting the clinical cutoff score for the Saving Inventory-Revised, a hoarding severity measure and will be randomly assigned to receive the intervention or to a waitlist control condition.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged 18 or order
* Residing in the United States
* Being interested in testing a self-help book for hoarding
* Meeting the clinical cutoff score for the Saving Inventory-Revised

Exclusion Criteria:

* Being under the age of 18
* Residing outside the United States
* Not having fluency in English sufficient to understand study materials
* Not being able to understand the study procedures
* Being suspected of being a bot/invalid respondent based on their responses
* Self-reported conditions that would interfere with participating (e.g., a disorder such as bipolar disorder or schizophrenia)
